thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: live-p95 and p99 spike in streaming path observed across regions. metric: streaming_response_p99 > 5s for 12m. potential cause: cache hit-rate drop on prefix cache. Auto-mitigation: routing fallback to 'small-model' pool for affected routes.

alex: seeing it. Paging oncall.

maya: oncall here, looking. which tenants?

incident-bot: top impacted customers by error/latency: [AcmeCorp, GreenLeaf, Shopsera]. p95 jumped from 350ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 6.3s. cache_prefix_hitrate dropped from 82% -> 19% after 2024-02-21T03:12:00Z deploy.

lee: I rolled prefixhash v2 earlier (deploy 2024-02-21T03:11:40Z). I saw a canary with some mismatch in namespace salting. Could be new salt causing under-sharding and low hit rates.

ana: @lee can you paste the deploy id and affected service?

lee: deploy id: sha@d4f7c1; service: runtime-prefixcache; cfg: salt_scheme=hashv2.

jordan: support is fielding a high-severity ticket from AcmeCorp — they report streaming sessions time out frequently. Customer-facing message ready?

alex: prioritize mitigation. steps: 1) rollback salt change on prefixcache to hashv1 for the affected pool. 2) enable degraded routing (already triggered) 3) warm cache using recent request traces.

maya: starting rollback on staging then prod. tagging @ops-bot for deploy.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: runtime-prefixcache rollback -> hashv1. CI checks passed. ETA ~8m.

lee: quick note: the new hashv2 increases prefix entropy intentionally for collision avoidance across buckets, but rollout may not have had compatible pre-salting for older entries. we should not flip until we backfill KV namespaces.

alex: understood. while rollback in flight, enabling aggressive prefix prefetch on live edge (lower TTL) to warm hotkeys.

maya: enabled prefetch for affected routes. Command used:

```
curl -XPOST https://ops.api/redwood/strategies/prefetch -d '{"route":"/stream/*","strategy":"aggressive","ttl":60}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

lee: pulling KVstats: sample output:

```
prefix_cache_hits: 842
prefix_cache_misses: 3578
hitrate: 19%
most_missed_prefixes: ["/search/images","/chat/context/large"]
```

jordan: AcmeCorp account shows 42 impacted sessions in last 15m, ETA to restore to SLO < 30m? customers asking for ETA.

alex: aiming for 30m to restore p99 < 1.5s by rollback + prefetch. if not, will open fallback blackhole on large-context routes.

incident-bot: rollback to hashv1 completed in 6m. rollout id: rb-20240221-01. No CI failures.

maya: monitoring. hitrate climbing: now 46% after 3m. p95 trending down to 700ms, p99 1.9s.

lee: also started a targeted KV rehash job to reintroduce older prefixes into new shard layout for the longer term. It will run low-priority and report progress.

ana: updated status to support and product: "Mitigation applied (rollback + prefetch). Investigating underlying mismatch in salt migration. Customer impact: transient p99 breach for major customers; mitigated, monitoring."

jordan: sending AcmeCorp update: "We've applied a rollback and are seeing improvements; short-term impact remains for some sessions — monitoring closely, will follow up in 1h."

maya: observational notes:
- Root cause: incompatible salt/hashv2 rollout without backfill of pre-salted keys.
- Impact window: ~03:12Z -> 03:18Z main mitigation; residual tail until 03:45Z as caches warmed.
- Metrics: peak p99 6.3s, dropped to 1.9s after rollback, expected <1.5s within 30m.

lee: plan for next 48h:
- pause further hashv2 rollouts
- implement a canary that verifies prefix hit-rate > 70% before full flip
- run KV rehash/backfill during low traffic windows
\alex: capturing action items in incident tracker. assigning owners: lee -> backfill job, maya -> follow-up monitoring & SLA report, ana -> customer comms, jordan -> post-incident support triage.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: triage complete, severity lowered to S2. Handoff to oncall-shift: maya (now), follow-up doc: /incidents/1726400000-postmortem (create within 24h).

maya: handoff note for next oncall: watch p95/p99 + prefix_cache_hitrate, and validate rehash job progress. leaving logs and command snippets in incident channel.

lee: dropping a quick repro of the hashing mismatch for infra docs:

```
# show salt map
redis-cli GET prefix:salt_map
# expected: {"scheme":"hashv1","salt":"abc"}
# got: {"scheme":"hashv2","salt":"zxy"}
```

ana: thanks team. Will draft the postmortem and schedule a 1hr RCA tomorrow.

alex: closing live bridge. if anything regresses, reopen here or page oncall. :thumbsup:
